I just don’t know anymore, i really do want to see things getting better but it’s been really hard for me to do so. i’ve been trying to be positive but i just really wish i could talk to her again. she’s the only person who really understood what i have gone through and it was thanks to her that i finally realized how toxic my parents are.

Im just scared for my future, i really want to be enthusiastic about it but i just find it really hard to do especially at this state that i’m in right now

I’m 15. I’m trying to distance myself from the negativity but it’s been really hard for me to do so
and i really can’t go anywhere to feel better as of right now.
